sloka: दृश्यमानो वसन्तः च स्वेद संसर्ग दूषकः ।माम् हि सा मृगशाबाक्षी चिन्ता शोक बलात्कृतम् ॥४-१-३५॥
transliteration: dṛśyamāno vasantaḥ ca sveda saṁsarga dūṣakaḥ ।mām hi sā mṛgaśābākṣī cintā śoka balātkṛtam ॥4-1-35॥

translations.english: 'O Saumitri the cruel breeze of the spring forest torments me as I am now immersed in grief in the absence of my fawneyed beloved.
